# DNS extension correlation controls

These files are scanned as data; never execute or install the retained extension.

`email-grabber-original.vsix` is the original JosephDembele95.email-grabber 1.0.6 specimen from the triage cohort. Its extension forks run.js, whose DNS TXT polling path decodes packets and evaluates returned code. Host information and evaluation output are serialized into DNS labels. The email-grabbing UI does not establish that collected email addresses enter that channel.

The three JavaScript controls are unchanged members from naatin777.latex-graphics-helper 0.4.0: socks-proxy-agent DNS resolution, a pump stream hex-encoding test, and pdf-lib Flate decompression. Their combined presence does not establish DNS exfiltration.

Run `python3 -I scripts/check-vscode-dns-tasking.py --cleave /path/to/cleave` from the traits repository. The runner also checks mutated original archives with evaluation removed, TXT resolution removed, and evaluation moved to a separate file.
